description: This file defines a React functional component 'Arc' that renders an animated elliptical arc in SVG, utilizing hooks for state and unique IDs for gradient definitions. It includes utility functions for calculating arc length, and manages styling and rendering logic for a visual component in a video or web application.

methods.name: getCircumferenceOfArc
